evidence_excerpt: deploy and integrate Robotic Process Automation solutions ... using software robots and artificial intelligence
evidence_summary: Milaha's official 2018 release says the company deployed and integrated RPA in back-office operations and explicitly describes the system as using software robots and AI for data entry processing and transfer.
adoption_interpretation: Operational AI is observed at the left edge of the panel; first adoption is left-censored at <=2018 unless pre-2018 evidence is collected. Milaha should not be treated as a post-2022 newly adopting firm in staggered-adoption analysis.
notes: The release explicitly says deployed and integrated, so this is stronger than a partnership/MoU. RPA alone would not qualify, but the source explicitly states AI is used by the deployed system.
